gameName: Adventure Games: The Gloom City File
firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently read or watched a thriller goes first.
houseFallback: If nobody qualifies, the timing is tied or unclear, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested house rule.
clarifications: Individual turns proceed clockwise, with movement, revealing a location card, and one action in that order.
Multiplayer participants each control at least one character. For solo play, choose two or more characters.
Specific instructions on cards or in the adventure book take precedence over the general rulebook.
